The '''Toblain sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Aricos Dreleene]] during [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule.<ref name="ss" />
